title: Expression and Purification of Glycine-Exposed GST-Tagged ATG8 Proteins in E. coli
author: Elisabeth Holzer
materials: Induce protein expression with 100 micromolar (µM) IPTG.

steps.title: Inoculate and grow starter culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate E. coli Rosetta™ (DE3) pLysS cells harboring the plasmid into 2× TY medium and grow at 37 °C with shaking.

steps.title: Shift temperature at mid‑log
steps.instruction: Monitor OD₆₀₀; when it reaches ~0.4, shift the culture temperature to 18 °C.

steps.title: Grow to target density
steps.instruction: Continue incubation at 18 °C until OD₆₀₀ reaches ~0.8.

steps.title: Post‑induction incubation
steps.instruction: Maintain the culture at 18 °C with continuous shaking for 16 h.

steps.title: Harvest cells by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the culture at 4000 × g for 20 min at 4 °C to pellet cells.

steps.title: Freeze cell pellets
steps.instruction: Flash‑freeze the cell pellets in liquid nitrogen and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend in lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Thaw pellets on ice and resuspend in ice‑cold lysis buffer.

steps.title: Lyse cells by sonication
steps.instruction: Sonicate on ice with two bursts of 30 s each at 60 % amplitude.

steps.title: Clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge lysates at 18000 rpm (~38 000 × g) for 45 min at 4 °C in a Sorvall RC6+ (F21S‑8x50Y rotor); collect the supernatant as cleared lysate.

steps.title: Equilibrate glutathione beads
steps.instruction: Equilibrate Glutathione Sepharose 4B beads in standard wash buffer.

steps.title: Bind protein to beads
steps.instruction: Incubate the cleared lysate with the equilibrated beads for 2 h at 4 °C on a rotating wheel.

steps.title: Remove beads and filter
steps.instruction: Pellet the beads by centrifugation, discard the beads, and filter the supernatant through a 0.45 µm filter.

steps.title: Wash affinity beads
steps.instruction: Perform the following sequential washes on the beads:

substeps.instruction: Wash 1: 1st wash with standard wash buffer
Wash 2: 2nd wash with standard wash buffer
Wash 3: wash with high‑salt wash buffer
Wash 4: 1st repeat wash with standard wash buffer
Wash 5: 2nd repeat wash with standard wash buffer

steps.title: Elute bound protein
steps.instruction: Elute proteins from the beads overnight at 4 °C using elution buffer containing 50 mM reduced glutathione in standard wash buffer.

steps.title: Concentrate eluate
steps.instruction: Concentrate the eluted protein with 10 kDa Amicon centrifugal filters.

steps.title: Size‑exclusion chromatography
steps.instruction: Load the concentrated sample onto a Superdex 200 Increase 10/300 GL column equilibrated in SEC buffer; collect fractions.

steps.title: Finalize protein preparation
steps.instruction: Pool desired fractions, concentrate, aliquot, snap‑freeze in liquid nitrogen, and store at –80 °C.
